::: {.obsidian-permit-to-work}
:::

State the work and the reason for the permit. Name
the system, the isolation points, and the area of work.

# Authorisation

Record who issued the permit, who accepted it, and the times.

# Precautions

List the precautions taken before work starts. Include isolation,
locking off, testing, and personal protective equipment.

# Handback

State the process for handing the system back. Name who verifies
the work and when the permit closes.
